title: Copies
text: Word gets round the colony that the cryo bank's genomes are on Kora now. Every family line. {who} finds you at the bank. "You gave them our lines. Our children. You didn't ask a single one of us."

choices.label: "It's a copy. In case."
choices.reply: "In case of what? In case of you?"

choices.label: "You're right. I should have asked."
choices.reply: "Yes. You should have." They go, but they go more slowly.

notes: The stance cost of engram-offer's accept, felt at home (stance needs the colony).
